sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Mahendra Nath Pandey Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Akanksha Gaur,C.S.C.,Pranjal Mehrotra Hon'ble Siddhartha Varma,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, Ms. Akanksha Gaur, learned counsel for the respondent nos.2, 3 and 4, Sri Pranjal Mehrotra, learned counsel for the respondent no.1 and learned Standing Counsel for the State.
When the petitioner was not being paid the compensation, he approached this Court by means of Writ C No.5759 of 2022 which was disposed of by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 01.12.2022.

sentences.text: "Be that as it may, prayer made in the writ petition would require a factual inquiry and in view of the prayer made by the petitioner, we do not find any good ground to keep the writ petition pending.

The writ petition is being disposed of with the observation that the petitioner shall move an application before the competent authority for disbursement of compensation in accordance with Section 3H of the National Highways Act appending all documents pertaining to right, title and interest of the land in question.

In case, such an application is filed within a period of three weeks along with the copy of this order, the competent authority shall be under obligation to take an expeditious decision determining the complaint made by the petitioner for disbursement of compensation by giving due notice or opportunity to all other stake holders.
In any case, an expeditious decision shall be taken within a period of eight weeks from the date of filing of the application. "
In pursuance thereof, the petitioner filed a representation before the competent authority/Additional District Magistrate, Land Acquisition Officer, Firozabad.
This representation came to be rejected on 27.03.2023 on the basis of the fact that review application had been filed before the arbitrator.
After the application was decided on 27.03.2023, the arbitration proceedings before the arbitrator also came to an end on 21.04.2023.

The petitioner has brought to the notice of the respondent no.5, Competent Authority/ Additional District Magistrate, Land Acquisition Officer, Firozabad that the arbitration proceedings had come to an end on 21.04.2023.
Under such circumstances, the Court is of the view that a fresh decision be taken by respondent no.5 taking into consideration that the arbitration proceedings have come to an end on 21.04.2023.

The competent authority shall now decide the representation of the petitioner dated 12.05.2023, which the petitioner had filed after the rejection of the arbitration proceedings, within a period of one month from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, in accordance with law.
With the direction above, the writ petition is disposed of.

Order Date :- 17.7.2023 A.Kr.
